in_sanskrit.name: Ehan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, Lord
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ehan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Ehan translates to 'He who rules', or 'The ruler'. This name is derived from the root word 'Eha' meaning 'he' and 'Han' meaning 'ruler' or 'lord'. In Hindu mythology, Ehan is a name of various deities, representing power, strength, and leadership.
